description: This file defines the internal class 'GrainLocator' responsible for locating and managing grain activations within a cluster. It provides methods for lookup, registration, unregistration, cache management, and updating cache entries related to grain addresses.

classes.name: GrainLocator
classes.description: An internal class that handles locating grains, registering and unregistering their addresses, and managing related caches within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the address of a grain by its ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the cluster, optionally replacing a previous registration.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a grain address from the locator, specifying the cause.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a grain address from the local cache without contacting the cluster.

methods.name: InvalidateCache
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries for a specific grain ID or address.

methods.name: GetGrainLocator
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate grain locator for a given grain type.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new silo address for a grain ID.

methods.name: UpdateCache
methods.description: Updates cache based on a provided update object, asserting cache validity or invalidating as needed.
